page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring that each of the 128 vCPUs has a dedicated physical core without hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high vCPU density make this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that require predictable, non-shared CPU resources. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio is optimized for parallel processing tasks such as high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and compute-intensive web serving, where raw processing power is prioritized over large memory footprints.
